description:
BATCH INSPECTION: run up to 32 GCP inspect probes in one call.
⚠️ **PREREQUISITE**: Same as gcpinspect — deploy attempt required.
Check convostatus for hasDeployAttempt=true before calling.

Use this when you need to check more than ~3 resources. The backend fetches
Oracle credentials ONCE per batch and fans out probes against a single GCP
credentials blob — a 12-resource health check is ~5–8× faster and 12× fewer
Oracle round-trips than calling gcpinspect 12 times.

BUDGETS:
- Up to 32 sub-probes per call (subs array length).
- 30s per-sub timeout; 60s total batch wall-clock.
- Concurrency cap 8.
- 512 KB response cap: subs past the cap keep their envelope
  (index/service/action/ok) but have result replaced with truncated=true.

PARTIAL FAILURE IS EXPECTED. The response is an ordered results array;
each entry has {index, service, action, ok, result, error}. Inspect each
result — do NOT abort on the first error. A credential fetch failure
leaves cred-less probes (list-actions, list-metrics) succeeding anyway.

REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...).
Supported services: apigateway, bastion, billing, certificatemanager, cloudarmor, cloudbuild, cloudcdn, clouddeploy, clouddns, cloudfunctions, cloudkms, cloudlogging, cloudmonitoring, cloudrun, cloudsql, compute, firestore, gcs, gke, iam, identityplatform, loadbalancer, memorystore, pubsub, secretmanager, vertexai, vpc
For a specific service's actions, use gcpinspect (singular) with
action="list-actions" — batch is not the place for discovery.
Batch responses are always summarized (no detail/raw per-sub); use
singular gcpinspect when you need full metadata or raw API output for one
resource.

EXAMPLES:
- gcpinspect_batch(session_id=..., subs=[
    {"service":"compute","action":"list-instances"},
    {"service":"gke","action":"list-clusters"},
    {"service":"cloudsql","action":"list-instances"}])
- gcpinspect_batch(session_id=..., subs=[
    {"service":"compute","action":"get-metrics","filters":"{\"hours\":6}"},
    {"service":"cloudrun","action":"get-metrics","filters":"{\"hours\":6}"}])

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing. The session must have a GCP deploy attempt before inspect probes will succeed.

subs.description: Up to 32 sub-probes, each with {service, action, filters?, detail?, raw?}. The backend fetches credentials once per batch and fans out probes in parallel (concurrency 8, 30s per-sub timeout, 60s total wall clock). Partial failure is expected — inspect each result.ok independently.

action.description: Operation on the service (e.g. 'describe-instances', 'list-buckets', 'list-actions' for discovery, 'list-metrics' / 'get-metrics' for time-series).

filters.description: Optional JSON-encoded filter object passed through to the underlying API. Examples: '{"hours":6}' for metric windows, '{"days":7}' for cost queries.

service.description: Cloud service to query (e.g. 'ec2', 'rds', 's3' for AWS; 'compute', 'storage', 'cloudsql' for GCP). Use the singular awsinspect/gcpinspect tool with action='list-actions' to discover supported services.

name: gcpinspect_batch

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

results.description: One entry per sub-request, in request order.

duration_ms.description: Time the sub-request took, in milliseconds.

error.description: Error message when ok is false.

index.description: Position of the sub-request in the request.

result.description: The sub-request result, with the same rules as the single inspect tool.

summarized.description: True when result is a compact summary.

truncated.description: True when result was dropped to keep the response under the size cap.

truncated_at.description: Index of the first sub-request whose result was dropped for size.

truncated_cap_bytes.description: Response size cap, in bytes, that caused the truncation.

title: Batch-Inspect GCP Infrastructure
